title: Yoisaki Kanade — The World Shown Through Music〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes. I even added in some of Yuki's lyrics as a test.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh, you mean the ones she wrote while she was out with the cold?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <It's not like I was writing them while curled up in bed.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Anyway, K, show us what you got!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Okay, but I'd like Miku and the others to hear this too, so mind if we meet in SEKAI?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What brings you all here today...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: We were hoping that you'd listen to the song we're currently working on.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The song that made Mafuyu smile?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. It even includes some of Mafuyu's lyrics.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I see... In that case, let me go find MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: While we wait, wanna talk some more about the Fan Festival?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! It's like a VIRTUAL SINGER appreciation event! All these performers come together to sing VIRTUAL SINGER songs♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No way. We just went to watch.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
No, you don't get it!
Seeing everybody perform was super fun too♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Especially since our idol friend was in it. I even sort of ended up becoming her fan.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Not really... I didn't feel anything.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I hardly ever listen to idol songs, but I thought the way she sang and danced during her performance really made her shine.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay, then, why don't you compose a song like that?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, I doubt that I could.
I'd have too much trouble coming up with that kind of melody.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. If I do learn how to someday, I may be able to give our song a bit more variety...
Hmm... Is there really any point in forcing yourselves to make music that you're not used to dealing with?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I mean, Mafuyu didn't feel anything from any of those performances, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But that's just a small glimpse into that particular genre. The answer could still be hidden somewhere within it, no?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, so what you're saying is that they should explore these genres more and see if there are any songs that can draw a response out of Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Um...
Thank you for joining us, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Don't mind me...
Start whenever you like.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Great! The way it started made me think it's better than it was before!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, I like this song a lot too.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I know that the lyrics are still a work in progress, but they seem to fit in really well.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I agree. Mafuyu makes it clear how she feels.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She does. This part felt so warm too...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Can't you just say that you liked it?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: By the way, Mafuyu, did you manage to figure anything out...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: As long as I have this song, I won't forget what I felt.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. Alright, let's do everything we can to make this our best song ever! This video's gonna be so awesome!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Just so you know, I try to draw the best illustrations I can for each video.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Would you mind showing that to me when it's finished?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Of course. I promise to make it into a good song.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'll be looking forward to it too...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (This may only be a small step forward...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But a very important one for Mafuyu, as well as me...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I need to make this song a good one.)
